summary: Report Fractal product names and builds in the connected-clients view

replay.detail: Client presence labels do not change stored events or replay inputs.

schema.detail: The existing optional x-st3-client header and client option are unchanged.

rules.detail: No checkpoint or coordinated member upgrade changes.

compatibility.detail: The CLI reports fractal instead of st. Updated first-party client entrypoints supply their product name and existing version or build, while internal Rust transports and two Swift stream helpers can still omit the header. The st3.client.class vocabulary is unchanged, but dashboard series shift: versioned fractal names classify as cli rather than fractal; fractal-web classifies as web rather than fractal; driver and replication-worker SDK traffic moves from cli to driver and replication-worker; previously unnamed producers move out of unknown into their product-specific classes; fractal-ios moves from fractal to app. Legacy spellings remain accepted. The daemon continues to display the name supplied by each client; older and unnamed clients remain supported.

downtime.detail: No daemon interruption or migration is required.

manual.detail: Operators see Fractal product names in connected clients after updating and reconnecting the corresponding clients. Dashboard owners should account for the st3.client.class series shifts described above when comparing historical traffic or using class filters; no client configuration changes are needed.

recovery.detail: No persistent state changes or new rollback restrictions.
